decision: hypothesis_rejected; do_not_deploy. Forcing question use through shared contexts did not improve answerable accuracy at 91M/1,200 steps and increased abstention. On held-out KLUE dev the control already varies its outputs across questions (identical outputs in 7 of 46 non-abstaining paragraphs), so the single-answer behaviour on RAG310 is one symptom of weak reading, not a pure data shortcut. Remaining explanation: 91M capacity / pretraining for passage-conditioned span selection. Next: scale the model (350M; CPU deployment ceiling ~1B); re-test the shared-context layout only as a controlled arm at that scale.
